description: Render a template filled with new content. "changes" maps the template's field keys to new values, e.g. {"w0.text": "Q3 Sales Review", "w5.labels": ["Jul","Aug","Sep"], "w5.datasets.0.values": [42, 51, 63]}. Fields not included keep the template's sample content. Replacing a whole list (e.g. "w7.values": [{"label": "A", "value": 40}, ...]) changes how many items it has; each item keeps the colours of the item it replaces. Returns the image and a link that opens the filled template in the GraphMake editor.

changes.description: Field key -> new value, e.g. {"w0.text": "Q3 Sales Review"}.

format.description: png (default) returns an image; svg returns the SVG markup as text.

name: render_template

bytes.description: Size of the PNG or SVG in bytes. The image itself is in the content.

editorUrl.description: Opens the result in the free GraphMake editor, where it can be restyled and exported as PNG, SVG or PDF.

width.description: Width of the returned image in px (tall templates come back narrower).

title: Render template
